attrs.price_range: $5-$10 per person for snacks and drinks

options.tradeoff: Can get crowded and noisy during peak hours
options.best_for: Groups who prioritize having a range of snack options

options.name: The Quiet Cup

attrs.price_range: $3-$8 per person for snacks and drinks

options.upside: Very quiet and peaceful atmosphere, ideal for focused studying
options.tradeoff: Limited food options and a bit of a drive from downtown
options.concern: Not many tables that can accommodate large groups

options.name: The Cozy Cafe

attrs.price_range: $8-$15 per person for snacks and drinks

options.concern: Not as comfortable for long study sessions
